'''Jabba's private box''' was one of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] houses in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], located in the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Grand Arena]].

==Occupants==
[[File:Champsroom.jpg|thumb|left|Room of Jabba's champion, filled with pointed spikes.]]
Jabba's private box was a personal house of Jabba, and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] used it when he attended the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]]. It is unknown whether he used it when there were no races to watch.<ref name="TPM" /> When Jabba was in the box, he was always accompanied by several of his servants and slaves, like his [[Interpreter (droid)|Interpreter]],<ref name="TPMvg" /> [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], [[Diva Shaliqua/Legends|Diva Shaliqua]],<ref name="TPM" /> [[Tann Gella/Legends|Tann Gella]],<ref name="TPMvg" /> [[R5-X2/Legends|R5-X2]], [[Chokk (Klatooinian)|Chokk]],<ref name="TPM" /> and many others.

Sometimes Jabba also invited guests to the suite, like his rival [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]<ref name="TPM" /> and the corrupt [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]].<ref name="TPMvg" />

There was at least one permanent occupant, a gladiator beast that was [[Jabba's champion]] in death matches. It lived in a small room, which was filled with pointed spikes, next to the arena of the suite. Jabba sometimes dropped fighters into the arena, and watched as they dueled the predator.<ref name="TPMvg" />

==Description==
[[File:Qui-GonJabba.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Qui-Gon Jinn meets with Jabba inside of Jabba's private box.]]
Jabba's private box wasn't as large as the Hutt's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]. The suite had few parts: the small room of Jabba's champion, the spike-pit arena, which was connected to the hall of Jabba's bed, and the balcony, which he used to watch the podrace.<ref name="TPM" /><ref name="TPMvg" />

==History==
{{Quote|Welcome. Begin the race!|Jabba starts the race in the balcony of his suite|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Champwithdagger.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Qui-Gon Jinn battles Jabba's champion in the arena of Jabba's suite]]
In 32 BBY, Jabba lodged the suite in order to attend the Boonta Eve Classic podrace. However, Jabba didn't care about the sport itself, and he only thought about the profits he would earn by betting on the race.<ref name="EITVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Jabba found the race itself to be boring<ref name="TPM" /> and he was always looking forward for new sources of entertainment. Jabba was more than happy to hear about the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] whose [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|ship]] had been stranded on Tatooine: [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] needed [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]] to make a bet with the junk dealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. Tann and [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann Gella]] showed Qui-Gon how to find Jabba, and when he arrived, Jabba lured the Jedi into the arena of the suite. He then promised to give the money to Jinn, if he could defeat his champion warrior. With no other options left, Jinn agreed, and he then proceeded to kill Jabba's champion in combat. Jabba thanked him for providing "worthy entertainment", and released him.<ref name="TPMvg" /> Shortly after this, Jabba started the race.<ref name="TPM" />
